products.subhead: Microprocessor-controlled vertical autoclaves with reliable safety functions for optimum sterilization
products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ST-G Series Autoclaves (Vertical Type) use microprocessor control with reliable safety functions to guarantee an optimum sterilization temperature, in a top-loading vertical design suited to high-volume sterilization.
features: High-Precision Control: A microprocessor controller with a temperature-calibration function allows high-precision temperature control, with sterilization from 110 to 123 C and melting (liquefaction of coagulated agar media) from 60 to 100 C.
Automatic Sterilization Cycle: An automatic sterilization system enables unattended operation, running heating, safety check, sterilization, sterilization-safe, exhausting and end in sequence.
Standard and Program Modes: Standard modes cover decontamination, solids, liquids and melting, and program modes allow custom temperature (110 to 123 C) and time (1 to 999 minutes) for varied uses.

Clear Monitoring: A VFD visualises temperature, pressure (optional), timer and warning-alert checks, LED lamps show the sterilization process, and a standard front pressure gauge makes pressure easy to read.
Vertical Top-Loading: The vertical, top-loading design suits high-volume sterilization, and baskets stack two high or more to make full use of the chamber.
Low-Maintenance Build: A corrosion-resistant stainless-steel chamber and an easy-to-replace silicone gasket keep maintenance low.

Documentation and Connectivity: An optional dot-type (6-point) data recorder supports documentation, LC GreenBox enables mobile monitoring, and 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper suits GMP audits.
Comprehensive Safety: Mechanical safety devices and warning systems protect users and loads (detailed in the Control & Safety section).

faqs.question: What is it used for?
faqs.answer: High-volume steam sterilization of media, liquids, solids and glassware, plus decontamination and agar melting, in a vertical top-loading autoclave.

faqs.question: What temperatures does it reach?
faqs.answer: Sterilization from 110 to 123 C and melting from 60 to 100 C.

faqs.question: Can it run unattended?
faqs.answer: Yes. An automatic cycle runs heating, safety check, sterilization, sterilization-safe, exhausting and end in sequence.

faqs.question: What modes are available?
faqs.answer: Standard modes (decontamination, solids, liquids, melting) and programmable modes with custom temperature and time (1 to 999 minutes).

faqs.question: How is it monitored?
faqs.answer: A VFD shows temperature, pressure (optional), timer and warnings; LED lamps show the process; and a front pressure gauge shows pressure.

faqs.question: What safety features does it have?
faqs.answer: Over-current, over-temperature (auto power cutoff) and over-pressure (auto and manual valve) protection, plus warnings for over/low temperature, low water, low heat and sterilization fail, and a burn-resistant slide door.

faqs.question: Is it GMP-ready?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the optional 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper software and a data recorder.

faqs.question: Can I monitor it remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, via the optional LC GreenBox mobile monitoring (up to 4 devices).

faqs.question: Are there altitude limits?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is not available for use at altitudes higher than 800 m.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help with validation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can support installation, IQ/OQ validation, training and after-sales service.

longForm.heroHook: Microprocessor-controlled vertical autoclaves with reliable safety functions for optimum sterilization
longForm.heroLead: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ST-G Series Autoclaves (Vertical Type) use microprocessor control with reliable safety functions to guarantee an optimum sterilization temperature, in a top-loading vertical design suited to high-volume sterilization.
heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ST-G Series Autoclaves (Vertical Type) use microprocessor control with reliable safety functions to guarantee an optimum sterilization temperature, in a top-loading vertical design suited to high-volume sterilization.

A microprocessor PID controller with a temperature-calibration function delivers high-precision control, an automatic sterilization cycle allows unattended operation, and convenient standard and program modes cover decontamination, solids, liquids and agar melting.
Four sizes - ST-50G, ST-65G, ST-85G and ST-105G (50 to 105 L) - offer a stainless-steel chamber, stackable baskets, a VFD display and comprehensive mechanical and warning safety systems.

sections.title: ST-G Series Vertical Autoclave at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the ST-G Series Autoclaves (Vertical Type) overview, features, applications, specifications, control and safety system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The ST-G Series Vertical Autoclaves sterilize high volumes of labware and media safely, with microprocessor precision.
body: The ST-G Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of vertical, top-loading autoclaves engineered for laboratories that need reliable, high-volume steam sterilization of media, liquids, solids and glassware.

A microprocessor PID controller with a temperature-calibration function holds the sterilization temperature precisely, and an automatic cycle - heating, safety check, sterilization, sterilization-safe, exhausting and end - allows unattended operation.

A stainless-steel chamber resists corrosion, stackable baskets make full use of the chamber, a VFD display with LED process lamps and a front pressure gauge keep the operator informed, and comprehensive mechanical and warning safety systems protect users and samples.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, validation support, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Built for reliable, high-volume sterilization
sections.description: The ST-G Series combines microprocessor control, an automatic cycle, standard and program modes, a stainless chamber and full safety systems.

sections.title: Applications
sections.description: From media and liquid sterilization to decontamination and agar melting, the ST-G Series suits microbiology, life-science, pharmaceutical and general laboratories.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the ST-G Series include 50 to 105 L chamber volumes, 110 to 123 C sterilization and microprocessor PID control.

Control is microprocessor PID. Pressure gauge range -0.1 to 0.6 MPa. Permissible altitude up to 800 m - the product is not available for use above 800 m. Standard accessories include an exhaust tank, step stool and drain bucket; recorders, a pressure sensor and communication options are available. Contact technical support for consultation and validation before purchasing.

sections.title: Control and Safety System
body: The ST-G Series pairs microprocessor control with mechanical and warning safety systems for safe, unattended sterilization.

groups.title: Mechanical Safety
items: Over-temperature protection by automatic power cutoff.
Over-pressure protection by automatic and manual safety valve.
Slide-opening door with a low-thermal-conductivity plastic cover to prevent burns.

groups.title: Warning Systems
items: Low-heat warning if the temperature does not reach the sterilization or melting temperature.
Sterilization-fail warning if the operation is unexpectedly stopped during the process.

sections.title: Configure the ST-G Series around your workflow
sections.description: Configurations and options of the ST-G Series include size selection, baskets, an exhaust tank, recorders, a pressure sensor and connectivity.

cards.title: LC DataKeeper
